section_a_check1_marlin_findings.workload: TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0-AWQ (INT4 AWQ-quantized, gemm version) on vLLM v0.21.0

first_run_eager_diagnostic.interpretation_1: CIPHER Marlin actuator is env-gated OFF by default (CIPHER_MARLIN=1 required). Counter stays 0 unless enabled.

critical_architectural_finding.interpretation: vLLM uses its OWN MacheteLinearKernel (vLLM-internal Marlin variant) for AWQ INT4 matmul. Machete is called via cuLaunchKernel DIRECTLY — bypasses cublasGemmEx entirely. CIPHER Marlin actuator (which sits at the cipher_rt_matmul_dispatch substrate hooked from cipher_rt_cublasGemmEx_impl) NEVER sees these calls because they don't go through cuBLAS at all.
critical_architectural_finding.implication: Path 2 audit's claim that 'Marlin engages via cuBLAS GOT under graph capture' is structurally TRUE but vacuously so — CIPHER Marlin DOES route through cuBLAS GOT WHEN cuBLAS is called, but on standard vLLM AWQ workloads cuBLAS is not on the INT4 matmul path. So CIPHER Marlin engagement on vLLM = 0 regardless of graph vs eager mode.
alternative_workloads_that_would_trigger: INT4 matmul routed through cublasGemmEx with CUDA_R_8I dtypes (not standard vLLM pattern; would need custom workload)

fp16/bf16 cublasGemmEx call where weight has been observed stable + meets Marlin gates (M<=64, N/K>=1024) — but Marlin substitution would require INT4 weight quantization which doesn't apply to fp16 weights
Net: NO standard vLLM workload triggers CIPHER Marlin actuator engagement

secondary_finding_va_pool_crash.log_line: RuntimeError: cipher_kv_bridge: slab_create failed (VA pool exhausted?)
secondary_finding_va_pool_crash.interpretation: AWQ model + gpu_memory_utilization=0.5 + cipher_kv_bridge VA pool sizing caused crash during model load. NOT a regression introduced by .8.5b.3; an edge case for AWQ models. Surfaced as honest observation; not the main finding.

section_a_check1_marlin_findings.verdict: REFUTED (in practical engagement sense) — Path 2 architectural claim about Marlin engagement on vLLM is structurally correct (wiring) but practically zero (no vLLM workload triggers it). Goal 2 (Marlin/VOLT) v1 customer benefit on vLLM via CIPHER substrate = 0.
section_a_check1_marlin_findings.memory_11_honest_residue: Goal 2 'Marlin/VOLT actuator engagement on vLLM' is ARCHITECTURALLY WIRED but PRACTICALLY UNTRIGGERED on standard vLLM workloads. v1 ship of Goal 2 needs honest framing: customer using vLLM gets vLLM's own Marlin (Machete), not CIPHER's overlay. CIPHER's Marlin actuator value is for custom workloads that route INT4 through cublasGemmEx OR for non-vLLM frameworks.

replay_delta.interpretation: +64 koopman observations during replay (some matmuls fire even during graph replay via the ~4% H2 launch leakage); +128 cuGraphLaunch calls (B.6''.9.8.4 shim engaging correctly)

section_b_check2_koopman_findings.verdict_engagement: PARTIALLY VALIDATED — Koopman observer DOES engage at cuBLAS layer in BOTH eager and graph modes (totals=8385 eager / 27329 graph; observer fires per cublasGemmEx call). This confirms Path 2 audit's architectural claim about observer engagement.
section_b_check2_koopman_findings.verdict_substitution: ZERO SUBSTITUTION in either mode — koopman_handled=0 in BOTH eager (0/8385) and graph (0/27329). Root cause: cipher_koopman_fp16_launch_shape returns -1 if shape not registered in .cu shape registry. Registry seeding requires cipher_edmd_live_collect background randomized-SVD pipeline to accumulate TARGET_ROWS snapshots; sustained workload + calibration time needed.
section_b_check2_koopman_findings.beta_residual_gate_under_replay_assessme: NOT EXERCISED in this test — the audit's theoretical concern (cipher_rt_koopman_engine.cpp:147 'cipher_koopman_fp16_ood_max_residual' β check captured at capture time, applied at replay regardless of new input distribution) requires Koopman to actually HANDLE a call (registry hit) before β check fires. Since handled=0 due to empty registry, β-gate-under-replay is theoretical only on this workload.
section_b_check2_koopman_findings.memory_13_korean_v1_actuator_status: Koopman is wired + observing but NOT substituting in v1 without registry calibration. The 'in-dist 90% top-1 r=64' performance claim (Memory #13) requires the registry to be populated for the target shapes — which requires either pre-seeded registry data OR live calibration during inference. Live calibration during normal vLLM workload was not observed to fire in this test (8385 cuBLAS calls eager; 27329 graph; zero registry hits).
section_b_check2_koopman_findings.memory_11_honest_residue: Goal 4 'Koopman O(1) substitution' v1 customer benefit on vLLM = 0 substitution in this workload. The substrate is wired correctly but downstream calibration loop is not converging within 8K-27K matmul observations. Goal 4 ship needs either (a) pre-seeded calibration data per supported model, (b) longer calibration warm-up before claimed engagement, or (c) honest framing that v1 Koopman is observation-only and substitution requires opt-in calibration step.

section_c_check3_sc6_findings.implication: SC6 is a kmod ARENA weight-sharing test (NRs 21-24) using transformers forward pass; vLLM CUDAGraph capture is not in the test code path. The 'graph mode' question doesn't apply to SC6.

section_e_recommendation.summary: Path 2 audit's empirical premise is OVERSTATED. Wiring is in place; practical engagement on real vLLM workloads is essentially 0 for both Goal 2 (Marlin) and Goal 4 (Koopman substitution) without additional work (workload customization for Marlin / registry calibration for Koopman).

Customer running standard vLLM today gets observer instrumentation (counters + telemetry) but no kernel substitution.

section_e_recommendation.no_hard_stop_warranted: Per discipline (g) and (h) — findings are honest residue, not correctness regressions. Outputs deterministic in all measured modes (rep0==rep1 in both eager + graph). No customer-observable correctness break. Just honest framing of v1 Goal 2/4 engagement level.
